title: Word Search II
statement: Return every word from the list that can be spelled by walking the board between side-adjacent cells, without using any cell twice within one word. Order does not matter and each found word is reported once.
constraints: a cell may not be reused within a single word, but words are independent of each other
the answer may be returned in any order
hints: Running Word Search once per word re-walks the same board thousands of times. The words share prefixes; exploit that.
Build a trie of the words, then run ONE backtracking search over the board, descending the trie as you step. Abandon a branch the moment the trie has no child for the letter you are standing on.

Two things make this fast enough: mark a word found at the trie node rather than searching for it, and prune the trie as you go - once a word is collected, clear its end marker, and leaf nodes with no children can be unlinked so later searches never revisit them.
complexity: O(cells * 4^maxWordLength) worst case, far less with pruning

cases.name: a word and its reverse both fit
cells cannot be reused within a word
